title: Agent relay can open a project, so create-then-generate lands in the right one
description: An agent driving Vision over the connector can CREATE a project (POST /create-project) but cannot OPEN it, so /connector/generate always runs in whatever project the human has open on screen. Create-then-generate therefore lands the output in the PREVIOUS project behind an ok:true response - a silent wrong-project run on paid GPU. FIX: add a project.open op to the agent relay. openProject() in js/services/projectService.js is already headless-safe (it migrates, reconciles, sets state.currentProject, registers the parent dir, emits project:changed); the two UI callers in js/shell/projectUI.js just pair it with navigate(PAGE_GALLERY). So this is a new POST /connector/open-project {folderPath} in routes/connector.js relaying through _dispatchToRenderer, plus a project.open case in js/shell/agentDispatch.js. agentDispatch.js is the DISPOSABLE half of MPI-546 - keep it dumb, one job in one result out; the HTTP route is the contract. Then flip step 3 of the 'Creating a project, then generating into it' sequence in .claude/skills/cubric-vision/SKILL.md from 'ask the user to open it' to the endpoint, and drop 'No project switching' from its What it does not do yet list.
